The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Smada]] employed a '''Gank assassin''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The Hutt sent the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] to shadow the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]]. They led the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to an abandoned laboratory, where they were accompanied by a local man named [[Ortolan/Legends|Bedo]]. The Gank shot Bedo.
